verdict.rationale: The only evidence of user-defined rules that fire actions automatically is a community report of accounts with "auto-funding rules", plus documented approval policies that gate money-movement requests. Webhooks and events (mercury-docs-42/43) are outbound notification building blocks, not a rules engine, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party docs for a configurable event-to-action rules engine, a list of supported triggers and actions, any AI-native or natural-language rule definition, and hands-on corroboration of how auto-funding rules are triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
